additional_info.subject: ID0465308-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / P1 170000220] DC2 point charging issue CRM:03056000667
additional_info.body:
Hi Szymon, good morning. Hope you are doing well.
There was a bug on the EcoG and I fixed it remotely with a reboot on the EcoG.
Since you don't have SSH access you cannot tell but this error is already addressed to R&D. If you see anytime this kind of error again where you just have the Outlet Error FLag and nothing else or even with the CableTempSensor error, please reach out to me via Teams directly because R&D wants to check the error live if they can do it.
I will close the ticket since the problem has been solved.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
